name: Helping Those In Need
overview: Scripture commands believers to generously open their hands to those in need, recognizing that poverty will persist in the land and that showing mercy honors God (Deuteronomy 15:11; Proverbs 14:31). Giving to the poor is depicted as lending to the Lord Himself, who promises to repay such kindness, and those who give generously will be blessed and lack nothing, while those who ignore the needy invite curses (Proverbs 19:17; 22:9; 28:27). Jesus reinforces this call to compassionate giving by instructing His followers to freely give and not turn away those who ask or borrow (Matthew 5:42).
